derivation: amendment A3: URL equality is exact after RFC 3986 normalization (scheme and host lowercased), so HTTPS://ALPHA.EXAMPLE/a equals the page url; the second alternate carries a different tag, so no duplicate pair.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-GB" href="HTTPS://ALPHA.EXAMPLE/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: clean-url-normalized-self
